title: Adversarial review of W0-STANDARD (standard)
final_text:
All probes ran with exit 0 (the four probe scripts were also run individually above, each with the output quoted in the review — `probe/guard_params.py` intentionally exits 1 because it reproduces the undeclared `TypeError` of finding SF1).

## Summary

**Review written:** `review/standard.md`.

**Probes written:** `probe/roundtrip.py`, `probe/int_oracle.py`, `probe/exhaustion_and_headers.py`, `probe/guard_params.py`, `probe/guard_params2.py`, `probe/parse_and_reconcile.py`, `probe/secondary.py`, `probe/more_attacks.py`. Nothing under `src/` or any other existing file was modified.

**Findings:**

- **BLOCKER:** none reproduced.
- **SHOULD-FIX SF1:** `_validate_params` (standard.py:1260–1264) checks `unanimity_rule`/`reopen_reasons` by truthiness/iterability only — `unanimity_rule=None`/list/int are accepted into the pinned body, and `reopen_reasons=0|None` escape `build_standard` as an undeclared `TypeError` with no code, breaking the "every wave-0 exception is a `LoopError`" convention.
- **SF2:** `assert_config_matches_standard` reconciles only 3 of the 12 frozen guard parameters (plus `len(judges)`), while deviation 8 and the docstring present it as the full `seats`-block reconciliation.
- **SF3:** `standard_body` validates shell only; bodies `build_standard` would refuse (weakened `judge_seats`, rewritten register text) parse without refusal, contradicting "refuse anything that is not one".
- **SF4:** interface note says `FORBIDDEN_KEYS` has 24 keys; the shipped object has 25 — which side is off is unresolved (upstream set not in sandbox).
- **NOTE N1/N2:** the header scanner sees only ATX/pipe spellings (setext/HTML headers pass — within its named scope but under renderer convention), and the exhaustion scan's detail quotes the flattened copy, not the record.

**Tried and could not break:** byte-stability/digest identity, cross-module object identity, the 12-integer oracle, the exhaustion-scan smuggle direction, the ceiling↔`BLOCK_CODES` correspondence, every integer/bool guard-parameter boundary, all four vocabulary-closing attacks, and the register-set refusals.

**Caveat recorded in the review:** the frozen snapshot carries no `tests/loop/test_*.py` modules, so integration counts in the interface note could not be re-run; all evidence is the probes.

Last test run: `python3 probe/roundtrip.py && python3 probe/secondary.py && python3 probe/exhaustion_and_headers.py && python3 probe/guard_params2.py` — exit code 0.
